_comment: Verified against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-08-18. Mirrored in salvorbench/cost/pricing.py; tests/pricing_test.py asserts the two agree, and the Node contract test reads this file.
notes: The $2/$10 introductory rate is now the STANDARD price. Anthropic's pricing page states the previously scheduled 2026-09-01 increase to $3/$15 will not occur, so no rate-change boundary is modelled.
Cache multipliers relative to base input: 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2x, read 0.1x.
Batch API (50% off) is NOT used — every arm runs synchronous requests.
inference_geo is left unset (global default, 1.0x). Pinning 'us' would apply a 1.1x multiplier.
